versions.content: If an event 1. uses Dem-internal debouncing (either counterbased or timebased) and 2. the Dem-internal debounce counter is incremented and reaches DemCounter- BasedFdcThresholdStorageValue or DemTimeBasedFdcThreshold- StorageValue and 3. the configuration parameter DemEventMemoryEntryStorageTrigger is set to DEM_TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD (refer to DemPrimaryMemory or De- mUserDefinedMemory ) and 4. no event event memory exists, the Dem module shall try to allocate an event memory entry in its configured event memory (refer to DemMemoryDestinationRef ).
